question: Through which amendment were the words 'socialist' and 'secular' added to the Preamble?
solution:
The correct answer is __**42nd Amendment**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **42nd Amendment Act** of the Constitution of India, enacted in **1976**, is often referred to as the "Mini Constitution" due to the significant changes it introduced.
 
• This amendment added the terms **'socialist'** and **'secular'** to the Preamble of the Indian Constitution to emphasize the commitment of India to social and economic equality and religious neutrality.
 
• The word **'integrity'** was also added to the Preamble to ensure the unity and harmony of the nation.
 
• The amendment was introduced during the Emergency period (1975-1977) when **Indira Gandhi** was the Prime Minister of India.
 
• The addition of these words aimed to reflect the growing importance of **social justice, equality, and secularism** in governance and public policy.
 
• The amendment also led to changes in other parts of the Constitution, including provisions related to the judiciary, fundamental duties, and the Directive Principles of State Policy.
 
• The inclusion of 'socialist' and 'secular' reinforced India's commitment to ensuring **social equality and religious tolerance**. These values are integral to the governance of India.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is the 42nd Amendment.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Preamble of the Indian Constitution:**

 
 
• The Preamble serves as the **introduction to the Constitution** and outlines the guiding principles and philosophy of the Indian state.
 
• It declares India as a **Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic, and Republic nation**.
 
• The Preamble is considered a part of the Constitution and can be amended under Article 368.
 
 
 
• **42nd Amendment Act:**
 
 
• The amendment was passed during the Emergency period and brought significant changes, including the addition of **Fundamental Duties** under Part IVA of the Constitution.
 
• It also curtailed the powers of the judiciary and increased the powers of the Parliament.
 
• The amendment aimed to strengthen the Directive Principles and reduce the scope of Fundamental Rights.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Socialist and Secular Values:**
 
 
• **Socialist:** Reflects the idea of reducing social and economic inequalities and ensuring equitable distribution of wealth.
 
• **Secular:** Ensures that the state does not favor any religion and treats all religions equally.
 
• These values are central to maintaining the harmony and unity of India's diverse population.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of the Preamble:**

 
 
• The Preamble is often referred to as the **identity card of the Constitution**.
 
• It reflects the aspirations and goals of the people and serves as a guiding light for constitutional interpretation.
 
 
 
• **Impact of the 42nd Amendment:**
 
 
• The amendment strengthened the role of the state in achieving social justice and religious harmony.
 
• It remains one of the most debated amendments due to its impact on the balance of power between the executive, legislature, and judiciary.
 
• Despite its controversies, the addition of 'socialist' and 'secular' highlights India's commitment to inclusive growth and religious neutrality.
